The atlas premise

Place is a collection of signals, not a stereotype.

Each card is a working title for a visual pattern: shaped by commerce, climate, media, movement and local reference. They are deliberately provisional until the signal can be traced, sampled and challenged.

The names below are editorial devices. They do not describe every resident, a demographic group, or a national character.

Evidence lab / current state

The archive is more honest than the label.

The first visual probe did not establish reliable fashion archetypes. It found that source collection and scene can overwhelm clothing similarity. The raw neighbor sheets, intervention tests and licensing record remain open here as the necessary counterweight to a seductive map.

Open the evidence lab ↗
01 / Gather

Aggregate commerce signals

Future research can compare category, price band, channel, purchase cadence and basket affinities at city or regional level. No individual shopping histories belong in this project.

02 / Triangulate

Test the visual claim

Pair those aggregate signals with consented street-style samples, retail panels and local editorial research. Require a clear provenance trail for every evidence layer.

03 / Publish uncertainty

Let the map change

Each map point keeps its confidence, sources and counterexamples visible. A card may be revised, split or removed when the data refuses the story.
